_comment: cloud-ci-authz-coverage gate policy (issue #770; AUTH-005 pipeline-as-product backstop). R0 pack-shaped DATA — all repo-specifics live here, the Rust engine is neutral. The gate detects axum Router control-plane surfaces (mutating route or per-resource path param) and requires fail-closed authz: a router-level auth layer (auth_layer_idents) OR every mutating handler invoking a recognized authz guard (authz_guard_idents). /healthz-style reads are exempt via exempt_path_substrings. Ratchets vs frozen_unauthenticated_surfaces (today's known surfaces) so the gate lands green and only NEW unauthenticated control planes block. The remediation doctrine is intelligence/adapters/rest + tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app.
_frozen_baseline_note: The currently-known unauthenticated HTTP control-plane surfaces as of issue #770 (born-baseline). Each is pre-existing debt owned by its capability team; this gate freezes them so it lands GREEN and blocks only NEW unauthenticated control planes. SHRINK-ONLY: when a surface is fixed (authz added) or removed, drop its key — a stale key self-cleans via AC-STALE-BASELINE. cluster-lifecycle does a header-trust tenant check (not a verified-principal authz decision); control-plane-host and tenant-quota derive no caller identity; ci-controller's /gate-run mutating route has no authz. Remediation per surface: see the doctrine in intelligence/adapters/rest + tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app.

product_contract.born_blocking: Born-blocking vs a frozen baseline of currently-known unauthenticated surfaces. The two reference surfaces (intelligence/adapters/rest, tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app) are GREEN by construction (they carry authz). Pre-existing unauthenticated surfaces are frozen in frozen_unauthenticated_surfaces (shrink-only). Only a NEW unauthenticated control plane blocks.
product_contract.pack_shaped: Neutral engine; every repo-specific is DATA in this file. A different repo adopts the gate by repointing the policy.
product_contract.fail_closed: No shell/network/VCS. A read-only walk of the candidate tree's Rust source. Malformed policy, gate-id mismatch, and a below-floor surface census all fail closed.
product_contract.remediation_doctrine: intelligence/adapters/rest/src/lib.rs (admin_tenant_allowed + PDP gate.decide + constant_time_eq) and tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app/src/lib.rs (authenticate_caller + authorize() per route).
